metadata.description: Foreman: a discipline layer for Claude Code (intake, planning, focus, evidence, guard, memory hygiene).

plugins.name: foreman
plugins.description: Plans, sequences, tracks and verifies work from terse prompts: evidence-gated briefs, focus lock, exact resume, a bypass-mode guard, drive mode and memory hygiene.

plugins.name: foreman-ui
plugins.description: Foreman inside Claude Code (mods): a docked dashboard pane that reads top-down by urgency (what needs you, the task with its stage rail and progress, what runs now, live charts of the session), a band above the prompt, toasts and one-press approve/next/drive/inbox actions. Needs a Claude Code build with function-hook plugins.
